📋 Daily Workout Plan Summary — Key Elements:
1️⃣ WARM-UP (5–10 min): Light jogging, dynamic stretches (leg swings, arm circles, hip rotations). Never skip!
2️⃣ CARDIO (20–45 min): Improves cardiovascular health. Mix steady-state (jogging, cycling) & HIIT.
3️⃣ STRENGTH TRAINING (30–45 min): Compound lifts (squats, deadlifts, bench press). 3–5 sets, 6–12 reps. Rest 48h per muscle group.
4️⃣ FLEXIBILITY / COOL-DOWN (5–10 min): Static stretches, yoga poses. Reduces soreness & improves range of motion.
5️⃣ REST & RECOVERY: 1–2 rest days/week. Sleep 7–9 hrs. Hydrate (2–3L/day). Prioritize nutrition (protein ~0.8–1g per lb bodyweight).
📌 Beginner: 3 days/week full body | Intermediate: 4 days upper/lower split | Advanced: 5–6 days PPL or bro split.
